identity: Blackwind Rise is the undead's grave country on the Throng's flank: the bone forest walks at night, and bandits sell the dead's linen to anyone who pays.

quests.title: Bears Under the Bone Trees
quests.text: Bonewood Plaguehide Bears roam the {name:bonewood} by day, {zone_area:bonewood}, and they have decided our runners are a snack. Kill four. I would do it myself, but I am mostly ash and opinions.

quests.title: The Trees That Walk at Night
quests.text: After dark the Lichen Gravewood Treants pull up their roots and wander the {name:bonewood}, {zone_area:bonewood}. Fell four and bring me two Bitter Resin; Ashveil burns it in the lamps, and the smell keeps the living at a polite distance.

quests.title: Word for Red Ramp Post
quests.text: The Throng does not hold this war from one hill. Drek Rampbinder keeps Red Ramp Post on Bannerbreak Mesa and always wants another blade. Tell him Ashveil still stands; he will pretend he was not worried.

quests.title: Down to Hollowarch
quests.text: Orrel Hollowstep keeps Hollowarch Station, closer to the Accord than I would like, and his work is heavier than mine. Go to him when you are ready. He hates waiting, which is odd for someone already dead.

quests.title: Bounty: Bonewood Bears
quests.text: The bears keep coming back to the {name:bonewood}, {zone_area:bonewood}. Kill six by day and Ashveil pays again twenty minutes later; the bears never learn, and neither does the purse.

quests.title: Weevils in the Webwood
quests.text: Marrow Weevils swarm the {name:webwood} by day, {zone_area:webwood}, and chew through every crate we leave on the trail. Kill four. Hollowarch runs on crates, not on good wishes.

quests.title: The Grave-Broker's Hideout
quests.text: Bandits have dug in at the {name:bandit_hideout} {dir_from_giver:bandit_hideout}, and the Grave-Broker Mute sells our dead's linen to anyone with coin. Kill four Entrenched Bandits or their archers, then end the Mute. He has never said a word; make sure he never needs to.

quests.title: Archers of {name:pallcloth_den}
quests.text: The {name:pallcloth_den} lies {dir_from_giver:pallcloth_den}, full of Entrenched Bandit Archers who shoot at anything under a Throng banner. Kill four. Good aim, poor judgement.

quests.title: Group: The Hollowbell Treant
quests.text: Deep in the {name:hollowwood} stands the Gravewood Treant Hollowbell, {dir_from_giver:hollowbell_treant}; on still nights you can hear it toll from here. It is far too strong for one fighter, so gather a group first. Bring it down and Hollowarch will sleep.

quests.title: Bounty: Hollowwood Spiders
quests.text: Grave-Web Bonelurker Spiders spin across the {name:hollowwood} at night, {zone_area:hollowwood}. Kill six and I pay; come back twenty minutes later and I pay again, because they will be back too.
